definitions.explanation: a person of exceptional courage, strength, or boldness, especially in a historical or literary context
someone who is audaciously bold, uninhibited, or larger-than-life in personality

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧{豪傑|ごうけつ}だ。
examples.english: He is a hero who left his name in history.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦国時代|せんごくじだい}→戦国時代：19200_sengokujidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{豪傑|ごうけつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}した→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Many great warriors were active during the Warring States period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何事|なにごと}→何事：11463_nanigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{動|どう}じない→動じる：30764_doujiru⟧{豪傑|ごうけつ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られていた→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He was known as a fearless man who was not shaken by anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{豪傑|ごうけつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{豪快|ごうかい}→豪快：14228_goukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{笑|わら}っていた→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather was a bold character who always laughed heartily.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{豪傑|ごうけつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: That company president is called a modern-day hero.

examples.japanese: ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何杯|なんばい}→何杯：08779_nanbai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{飲|の}める→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{豪傑|ごうけつ}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧だ。
examples.english: He has the boldness to drink any number of cups of sake.

notes:
Composed of {豪|ごう} (powerful, grand) and {傑|けつ} (outstanding person). Originally referred to warriors and heroes of great strength and courage. In modern usage, it also describes someone with a bold, uninhibited personality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪傑|ごうけつ}⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧: a bold, hearty laugh
- {豪傑|ごうけつ}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: heroic manner, bold character
- ⟦{天下|てんか}→天下：12188_tenka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{豪傑|ごうけつ}: a hero of the land

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{英雄|えいゆう}→英雄：14117_eiyuu⟧: hero — more general and elevated; used for national or legendary heroes
- ⟦{勇者|ゆうしゃ}→勇者：11925_yuusha⟧: brave person — emphasizes courage; often used in fantasy and gaming contexts
- ⟦{猛者|もさ}→猛者：13623_mosa⟧: tough person, veteran — emphasizes strength and experience in a specific field
- ⟦{豪快|ごうかい}→豪快：14228_goukai⟧: bold, hearty — an adjective describing the manner often associated with a {豪傑|ごうけつ}
